title: Camouflage Shelf Sprint
oneLiner: A browser party toy where friends hide product stickers in a chaotic shelf photo and vote on the funniest invisible placement.

sourceSignals.title: Meccha Chameleon proves cheap hide/fool/clip party loops can explode when the rule is instant
sourceSignals.source: Windows Central / PC Gamer / GamesRadar, June-July 2026

sourceSignals.title: AI budget visibility is weak even for business leaders

stitchPrompt: Create a playful browser party prototype called “Camouflage Shelf Sprint.” Show a lobby rule card, a chaotic grocery or cosmetics shelf playfield, sticker palette, tint/scale/rotate controls, a 20-second seeker timer, reveal animation, and vote results for stealth/funniest/most cursed. Design direction: use the playful-experimental profile with a bold but readable composition, one vivid accent, tactile controls, and a shareable first impression.
